items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1976-02-19
items.q: which would have been of the Coltrane persuasion

ctx.x: Well, would Beiderbeck be playing bop, then, today, if he were alive?

I think he would have gravitated to that and possibly contributed to making some kind of sense out of it. I believe that he would have played bop during the period when it was popular. But I believe that he would have eventually drifted off into some non-objective area, which would have been of the Coltrane persuasion, rather than in any real organized way.
Wouldn't he have been closer to a more melodic lyrical player, like maybe Chet Baker?
